card.name: The word after full or half
card.fires_on: The word right after "full" or "half", mostly "stop" in "full stop" or "half stop". It also fires weakly on "full" after "half" or "completely", and on "term", "replacement" or "screen" after "full".

modes.label: Full as a state
modes.description: "full" after "half" or "completely", describing how filled something is.
modes.example: If it is only half<< full>>, it is 50% full

modes.label: Full plus noun
modes.description: A noun directly after "full", as in a phrase like full term or full replacement dose.
modes.example: Adults diagnosed with hypothyroidism Full<< replacement>> dose is 1.6 mcg

card.plain: It marks the word that completes phrases like "full stop", "half full" or "full term".
